purpose: Give every approach the same host-owned task authority without putting credentials or graders inside evolved code.

operations.name: run_command
operations.workspace_mode: fresh container, argv only, workspace state persists
operations.harbor_mode: fresh task environment, persistent shell, system and workspace state persist through verification

invariants: The task container, mounted repository, visible prompt, and operation schemas are identical across approaches.
Provider credentials remain in the broker process and are never present in task or candidate environments.
Evaluator-private files, task IDs, tests, expected outputs, and grader logs are never broker-readable.
Every request, response, error, duration, token count, tool count, and cost is appended to the attempt trace.
Budget denial is a recorded task outcome and cannot be retried outside the attempt.
Command mechanics are frozen per suite and identical across approaches: argv-only fresh commands for local workspace tasks, persistent Harbor shell commands for official SWE and Terminal tasks.
Every Harbor attempt starts one fresh official task environment; provider inference remains host-side and the verifier runs only after the agent phase.
Network is denied unless a suite preregisters the same scoped network capability for every approach.
